title: SynthEye: Investigating the Impact of Synthetic Data on Artificial Intelligence assisted Gene Diagnosis of Inherited Retinal Disease
short_title: SynthEye: synthetic data and AI diagnosis of inherited retinal disease
abstract: Synthetic generation of realistic IRD FAF images is feasible. Synthetic data augmentation does not deliver improvements in classification performance. However, synthetic data alone deliver a similar performance as real data, and hence may be useful as a proxy to real data.Financial Disclosure(s): Proprietary or commercial disclosure may be found after the references.
summary: We studied whether synthetic images can support AI-assisted gene diagnosis of inherited retinal disease (IRD). Generating realistic synthetic IRD images (FAF images) proved feasible. Adding synthetic images to real data did not improve classification, but synthetic data alone performed similarly to real data and may serve as a proxy for it.
key_findings: Generating realistic synthetic FAF images of inherited retinal disease is feasible.
Augmenting the data with synthetic images did not improve classification performance.
Synthetic data alone performed similarly to real data and may be useful as a proxy for real data.
